guide.title: Print settings for your device
guide.cannotCheck: A web page cannot see or change the print window, so these settings are yours to choose, and we cannot check them for you. If the PDF comes out on the wrong paper size, with white pages or without colours, print again with these steps.

chromium_desktop.name: Chrome or Edge on a computer
chromium_desktop.step1: Press "Print or save as PDF" below (Ctrl+P or Cmd+P does the same).
chromium_desktop.step4: Margins: None. Scale: Default (100). Headers and footers: off.
chromium_desktop.step5: Background graphics: on. Then press Save.

safari_desktop.name: Safari on a Mac
safari_desktop.step1: Press "Print or save as PDF" below (or choose File > Print).
safari_desktop.step2: Paper Size: {{size}} (for Letter, choose US Letter).
safari_desktop.step3: Open the menu that says Safari in the print panel, tick Print backgrounds and leave Print headers and footers off.
safari_desktop.step4: Scale: 100 %. There is no margin setting: the pages already fill the sheet.
safari_desktop.step5: Click PDF at the lower left, then Save as PDF.

firefox.name: Firefox on a computer
firefox.step1: Press "Print or save as PDF" below (Ctrl+P or Cmd+P does the same).
firefox.step4: Under Options: tick Print backgrounds and leave headers and footers off.

chrome_android.name: Chrome on Android
chrome_android.step1: Press "Print or save as PDF" below, or open the menu (three dots) > Share > Print.
chrome_android.step2: At the top, choose Save as PDF.
chrome_android.step3: Tap the arrow to open more options. Paper size: {{size}}. Margins: None.
chrome_android.step4: Look at the preview: the coloured pages must show. Android's print window does not always offer a background option; if the colours are missing, press "No" in the question below so that we know.
chrome_android.step5: Tap the PDF button to save the file. For a long book a computer is more reliable.

safari_ios.name: Safari on an iPhone or iPad
safari_ios.step1: Tap Share (the square with an arrow), then Print. Or press "Print or save as PDF" below.
safari_ios.step2: In the print preview, spread two fingers apart on the first page: the preview turns into a PDF.
safari_ios.step3: Tap Share again, then Save to Files. iPhone and iPad choose the paper size themselves, so the PDF may not be {{size}}; the pages keep their proportions.
safari_ios.step4: Check the PDF: every page is there and the colours show. For a book with many photos a computer is more reliable.

other.name: another browser
other.step4: Turn headers and footers off and background graphics on.

feedback.thanksNo: Thank you, we have counted it. Please check the steps above once more: paper size, margins and background graphics. A computer gives the most reliable PDF.
